arms.one_entry: one filled entry per game; same exit, fees, liquidity, freshness and loss guards

hypothesis: Reduce repeated transaction costs and repeated exposure to the same forecast. Exploratory risk-reduction test, not a predicted profitable strategy.
evaluation: Preregistered future games only. Compare matched arms on identical newly observed inputs and reader delay. Report net, costs, entries, drawdown, missed subsequent winners and unresolved exposure separately by game and holding horizon. Lower activity alone is not success. No tuning or promotion until all matched cohort games complete. Existing live3.3 remains unchanged.
